faq.question: How does Homayar analyze a call?
faq.answer: Every recorded or uploaded call passes through a structured pipeline: speech-to-text transcription with speaker separation, followed by a team of specialized AI agents that each handle one job — quality scoring, issue detection, sentiment tracking, compliance checks, and coaching analysis. Their findings are consolidated into a single call record with a QA score, flagged moments, and recommended actions. A typical 10-minute call is fully analyzed in under 90 seconds.

faq.question: Which languages does Homayar support?
faq.answer: Homayar supports transcription and analysis in more than 30 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, and Persian, with automatic language detection per call. Mixed-language conversations are handled at the segment level, so a call that switches languages mid-conversation is still scored accurately. Contact us if you need a specific language or dialect validated before rollout — we run an accuracy benchmark on your own sample calls.

faq.question: How accurate is the transcription and scoring?
faq.answer: On clear telephony audio, transcription word accuracy typically lands between 92% and 97%, depending on language, audio quality, and domain vocabulary. QA scoring is calibrated against your own rubric: during onboarding, your QA team reviews a sample set side by side with Homayar, and we tune agent scoring until alignment reaches an agreed threshold — most teams target 90%+ agreement with human reviewers. You can audit any score back to the exact transcript moments that produced it.

faq.question: Can we try Homayar before committing?
faq.answer: Yes. Most teams start with a guided pilot: you upload a representative batch of recorded calls, and within a few days you review real scores, detected issues, and coaching insights from your own data — not a canned demo. Pilots run on a standard agreement with full deletion of your audio and transcripts at the end if you decide not to proceed. Book a demo and we will scope the pilot with your QA lead.

faq.question: How long do you retain our call data?
faq.answer: You set the retention policy. By default, audio is retained for 90 days and transcripts plus analysis results for 13 months, but both windows are configurable per workspace — from delete-after-processing to multi-year retention for regulated industries. Deletion requests are executed across primary storage and backups within 30 days, and every retention setting is logged for audit purposes.

faq.question: Does Homayar redact personally identifiable information?
faq.answer: Yes. Automated PII redaction runs during transcription and can mask names, phone numbers, payment card numbers, national ID numbers, addresses, and dates of birth in both the transcript and the audio waveform. You choose the redaction mode per data type — full removal, tokenized placeholders, or role-restricted visibility — so QA teams see what they need and nothing more.

faq.question: What is your security posture? Are you SOC 2 certified?
faq.answer: Homayar's controls are designed to align with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 frameworks: encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256), role-based access control, single sign-on via SAML and OIDC, comprehensive audit logging, and annual third-party penetration testing. We do not claim certifications we have not completed — our current attestation status and audit reports are available under NDA through our trust page. Enterprise customers receive a completed security questionnaire and our full controls documentation during procurement.

faq.question: How does Homayar address agent privacy and works-council requirements?
faq.answer: Homayar is built as a companion to agents, not a surveillance layer — and the product enforces that distinction technically. Workspaces can disable individual performance rankings, restrict per-agent views to the agent themselves and their direct coach, anonymize team-level analytics, and exclude defined call types from analysis entirely. We provide a works-council documentation pack covering data flows, access roles, and configuration options, and we routinely adapt deployments to codetermination agreements in Germany, Austria, and the Netherlands.

faq.question: How is Homayar priced?
faq.answer: Pricing is based on analyzed call volume — measured in audio hours per month — with plan tiers that bundle seats, retention, and integrations. There is no per-seat charge for agents whose calls are analyzed; only supervisor and admin seats count toward seat limits. Enterprise plans with VPC deployment, custom retention, and dedicated support are quoted annually in USD. Volume commitments reduce the effective per-hour rate.

faq.question: Can we change plans mid-contract?
faq.answer: Upgrades take effect immediately, with the price difference prorated for the remainder of your billing period. Downgrades take effect at the next renewal so your historical data and configured workflows are never interrupted mid-cycle. If your call volume grows past your tier, overage is billed at your contracted per-hour rate rather than blocking analysis — your pipeline never stops because of a billing threshold.

faq.question: What is your refund policy?
faq.answer: Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time and are not billed for subsequent months; we do not refund the current month once analysis has run. Annual contracts include a 30-day evaluation window: if Homayar does not meet the success criteria agreed during onboarding, you can exit with a prorated refund of the unused term. Unused committed volume does not expire mid-contract — it rolls forward within the contract year.

faq.question: What deployment options are available?
faq.answer: Homayar runs as a managed multi-tenant cloud service by default, with data residency options in the US and EU. Enterprise customers can deploy in a single-tenant VPC — in your AWS, Azure, or GCP account — so audio, transcripts, and analysis results never leave your network boundary. Both models run the same analysis pipeline and receive the same release cadence; the VPC option adds your own KMS keys, network controls, and infrastructure audit access.

faq.question: Which CRMs and helpdesk tools does Homayar integrate with?
faq.answer: Native integrations cover Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Zendesk, and Freshdesk. Call scores, detected issues, and coaching notes sync to the matching contact, case, or opportunity record, so supervisors work inside the tools they already use. A REST API and webhooks handle custom CRMs and internal systems — most teams complete a custom integration in one to two sprints with our integration guide.

faq.question: How do calls get into Homayar from our telephony system?
faq.answer: Three ingestion paths are supported: direct connectors for major platforms including Genesys Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect, Twilio Flex, Cisco, and Avaya; SFTP or S3 batch upload for existing recording archives; and a streaming API for custom telephony stacks. Recordings arrive with their metadata — agent ID, queue, disposition, timestamps — so analysis is fully attributable from day one. Most connector setups complete in under a week.

about.missionBody:
Call centers generate thousands of hours of conversation every week, and almost all of it goes unheard. Traditional quality assurance samples 1 to 2 percent of calls, scores them days later, and turns coaching into an argument about a spreadsheet. The customer's actual voice — what frustrated them, what convinced them, what they asked for and never got — disappears into storage. Homayar exists to close that gap: a team of specialized AI agents that listens to every call, scores it against your own quality standards, surfaces the issues that matter, and turns raw conversation into decisions your operation can act on the same day.

We built Homayar on a conviction that shapes every product choice we make: analysis should be a companion, not a camera. The goal is not to catch agents failing — it is to show every agent, supervisor, and operations leader exactly what is happening across 100 percent of their conversations, with the evidence to back it up. When coaching is grounded in real moments instead of gut feel, agents improve faster, supervisors spend their time where it counts, and the call center becomes what it should have been all along: measurable.
about.nameStory: The name carries two ideas. Homa is the fortune-bird of Persian mythology — a creature said never to land, flying unseen above, and bringing good fortune to anyone its shadow touches. Yar is the Persian word for companion: the one who stands beside you, not over you. Together they describe exactly what we set out to build at KSF Company — an intelligence that moves quietly above every conversation, touches each one, and leaves the people below better off for it. Not a watcher. A companion that brings fortune to every call.

values.name: Companion, not surveillance
values.description: We build for the agent on the phone as much as for the leader reading the dashboard. Features that help people improve ship; features that exist only to police people do not.

values.name: Evidence over opinion
values.description: Every score, flag, and recommendation traces back to a specific moment in a real conversation. If a number cannot be audited to its source, it does not belong in the product.

values.name: Precision before scale
values.description: An analysis platform is only as valuable as it is trustworthy. We calibrate against your QA team, publish our accuracy ranges, and tune until the numbers hold — then we scale.

values.name: Privacy by design
values.description: PII redaction, configurable retention, role-scoped visibility, and works-council-ready controls are core architecture, not enterprise add-ons. Customer data is analyzed, protected, and deleted on your terms.
